decision.name: STOP_SPECULATIVE_EXPANSION_REQUIRE_EXACT_SHA_EXECUTION
decision.finding: Re-read pinned P0 and P1 regression contracts and exact public runner/storage source. Corrected P0 conditional wait avoids false rejection of a valid serialized writer. P1 covers same-ID/distinct-ID cross-process archive admission. Public runner still publishes three separate files; storage guarantees individual file atomic replacement only. Existing test-only P0/P0.5/P1/failpoint contracts are sufficient for the next execution decision; no new speculative contract or source-only GREEN verdict is justified. Worker-control is not a valid test substitute (12 tests versus 17 on public HEAD).
decision.next_acceptance: Use an authorized isolated exact-public-SHA checkout with 17 tests. Verify HEAD and test inventory; run unchanged baseline, pinned test-only concurrency/failpoint overlays, targeted pytest and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Preserve actual exit codes, logs, overlay hashes and overlap witnesses. Reader fail-closed alternative remains NOT_EVALUABLE until production reader API exists.
